name: Code-tag chips pile up under a typed claim
looks: A short claim types on with a blinking caret, a handful of small code-style tag chips (each a bracketed technique name) sitting below it. A beat later many more chips flood in and pile up in a dense cluster beneath the same claim, as if to prove the claim by sheer volume.
build: Claim text types on character by character, caret blinking continuously rather than disappearing. Chips are small bordered mono pills; the first handful pop in with a light stagger, then a much larger wave pops in fast and tight (20-30ms apart) to read as a flood rather than a list.
sound: A soft mechanical key-tick under the typed claim, a fast patter of light pops as the chip flood lands.
prompt: Type a short claim with a persistent blinking caret, a few small bracketed tag chips sitting beneath it, then flood in many more chips in a fast, tight wave so the pile-up itself proves the claim's scale at a glance.
